title: Basis Questions on Agreement-Year Redemptions and the Spend-Milestone Bonus, Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Which redemptions bear on a spend-milestone bonus of a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement?**
The points redeemed from the agreement in its current agreement year, counted as the redemption entries dated fewer whole calendar months before the credit date than the milestone pace plus one. The milestone pace is the number of whole calendar months the current agreement year has run at the credit date, counted from the latest anniversary of the approval date.

**What allowance do they add?**

| Points redeemed in the current agreement year | Redemption allowance |
|---|---|
| 3000 points or more | 250 points |
| at least one point, below 3000 | 100 points |
| none | nothing |

**How does the allowance act?**
The redemption allowance is added, in points, to the milestone bonus before its allowance — the milestone bonus as it stands after any percentage uplift has been applied and rounded. The result is the milestone bonus with its allowance.

**What counts toward the 3000 points?**
The points on every redemption entry in the count — award tickets, upgrades and status awards alike — added together.

**Example (hypothetical).** Redemptions of 1600 and 1600 points in the current agreement year make 3200 points: an allowance of 250 points, and a milestone bonus before its allowance of 7000 points becomes 7250 points.
